# Demonstrates: bbox2d roles for layout-to-image consumers (GLIGEN, ControlNet).

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle eye_level :focalLength 50mm :framing medium_shot)
   :viewedBy cam
   :depicts (apple / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
               :class Apple
               :bbox2d "0.42,0.55,0.12,0.14"
               :hasQuality (q / Quality :dimension Color :value red))
   :depicts (table / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
               :class Furniture
               :bbox2d "0.10,0.60,0.80,0.30"))
